title: Corrosion inhibition and in silico toxicity assessment of imidazo[1,2-a]pyrimidine-Schiff base derivatives as effective and environmentally friendly corrosion inhibitors for mild steel
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12342-12363
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02000J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohamed Azzouzi, Walid Daoudi, Omar Dagdag, Avni Berisha, Hansang Kim, Abdelouahad Oussaid, Abdelmalik El Aatiaoui, Adyl Oussaid
Two novel imidazo[1,2-a]pyrimidine-Schiff base derivatives were synthesized and evaluated as efficient, eco-friendly corrosion inhibitors for mild steel in acidic media using electrochemical, theoretical, and toxicity assessments.
